name: Coronation of Bolesław I the Brave of Poland
summary: Bolesław I crowns himself king of Poland at Gniezno in 1025, weeks before his death. The Holy Roman Empire opposes the title; the crown is lost in subsequent civil war and not formally renewed until 1295.

_quarry.structural_significance: First Polish royal coronation; asserts Poland's status as an independent kingdom outside the imperial framework. Establishes Gniezno as the Polish coronation site and the cult of St Adalbert as Polish national patron.
